subject.title: skill_workshop: quarantined proposals are CLI dead-ends (no apply/revise/reject path back)

question: Which recovery transition, if any, should quarantined Skill Workshop proposals support?
rationale: Current shipped docs and tests intentionally make non-pending proposals terminal, and changing quarantine recovery affects scanner, audit, and safety semantics across public CLI, Gateway, tool, and UI surfaces.

options.title: Add audited quarantine recovery
options.body: Support a bounded path such as reject-from-quarantined plus revise-to-pending only after a fresh scan and explicit audit fields.

options.title: Unify with restore semantics
options.body: Wait for the rejected-proposal restore direction to settle, then extend the same public restore model to quarantined proposals if maintainers want one recovery verb.

options.title: Keep quarantine terminal
options.body: Document quarantine as an immutable safety hold and direct users to recreate clean proposals when recovery is unsafe.

recommendation.title: Add audited quarantine recovery
recommendation.body: Support a bounded path such as reject-from-quarantined plus revise-to-pending only after a fresh scan and explicit audit fields.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice needs current lifecycle/security direction, and vincentkoc has recent Skill Workshop and release-history proximity.
